# C-Safe Wellness Group

> C-Safe Wellness Group is a discreet, high-touch B2B advisory firm providing confidential mental health and addiction support exclusively for C-suite executives at mid-to-large companies.

C-Safe is based in Atlanta, Georgia and serves companies nationwide. We are not an Employee Assistance Program (EAP), a treatment center, or a call center. We are an independent executive behavioral health advisory firm that operates on a retainer basis — giving each covered executive unlimited access to our team and a curated 12-month wellness experience.

## Core Services

- Executive mental health and addiction treatment placement and coordination
- Family and stakeholder support (up to 2 treatment episodes annually per covered executive)
- Transport and safety logistics
- Interventions (when clinically indicated)
- Corporate crisis response (24-hour activation)
- Preventive executive wellness programming (quarterly assessments, monthly events, team-building)
- Executive hiring support with psychological assessment in partnership with HR

## Who We Serve

Mid-to-large companies, especially founder-led, private equity-backed, and public companies in high-stress industries: finance, healthcare, law, technology, logistics, construction, and entertainment.

## What Makes C-Safe Different

- 24-hour response time — no waiting lists, no public intake
- Retainer model — unlimited access for covered executives throughout the year
- Strict confidentiality — all records and communications exist entirely outside company systems
- Independent advocacy — we have no beds to fill and no provider relationships that compromise our recommendations
- Full-spectrum support — from proactive wellness to acute crisis response

## Pricing

Annual retainer: $10,000 per covered executive per year. Family coverage available at an additional $10,000 per executive (includes 2 treatment episodes annually). Add-ons available for transport, interventions, same-day deployment, corporate groups, and hiring psychological assessments.
